mainEntity.name: Can a custom fireplace surround improve my home's energy efficiency?

acceptedAnswer.text: While a custom fireplace surround primarily enhances aesthetics, it can indirectly contribute to energy efficiency if designed and installed correctly. A well-sealed and insulated surround can help prevent drafts and minimize heat loss through gaps around the fireplace insert. However, its primary role is decorative. To significantly improve energy efficiency, focus on the fireplace insert itself, ensuring it's an efficient model with proper venting and a tight-fitting damper. We focus on ensuring a tight seal for any new surround to complement your fireplace's efficiency.
acceptedAnswer.description: A custom fireplace surround primarily enhances aesthetics, but proper sealing can indirectly help prevent drafts. Significant energy efficiency gains come from the fireplace insert itself.
